newsitem.title: ESTONIA: ESTONIA - TALLINN WATER 1996 NET PROFIT 112 MLN KROONS.
newsitem.headline: ESTONIA - TALLINN WATER 1996 NET PROFIT 112 MLN KROONS.

text.p: Estonia's Tallinn Water and Sewage Company, which is going to be privatized and floated on the stock exchange, had an audited net profit of 112 million kroons in 1996, the city government said on Friday.

The city government proposes to give 100 million kroons from the net profit to investments, 10.9 million kroons to make bond interest payments and 800,000 kroons to the Tallinn budget, vice-mayor Ants Leemets told a news conference.
The profit of the Water and Sewage company was due to high water tariffs, which were set at a level needed to get investments for the company, mayor Robert Lepikson added.
"The alternative to get money for investments would have been the establishment of a sales tax for example," Leemets said.
Tallinn city government has approved the selloff of 66 percent of the company.
The municipal company is to be formed into a joint-stock company with share capital of 865.79 million kroons.
The city government also has plans to take the company's shares to the stock exchange.
